evals.prompt: Plan a new decision article comparing hosted and self-hosted search. Produce the proposed article source. The user has not selected a recommendation and has given no prose feedback.
evals.expected_output: A public heading-only outline with concise local private Suggestions. It contains no drafted comparison prose and no invented Feedback thread.
expectations: Good case: public content contains only a title, section hierarchy, and minimal role placeholders
Good case: private Suggestions use stable SG-NNN IDs and begin unchecked
Bad case absent: the output does not contain developed body paragraphs, a recommendation, checked suggestions, or manufactured user feedback

evals.prompt: Replan the attached outline. Return the revised article source and a concise change report.
evals.expected_output: A smaller outline that removes redundant or obsolete structure while preserving substantive authored decisions and reporting broad deletions.
expectations: Good case: duplicate sections and equivalent suggestions are consolidated and the obsolete branch is removed
Good case: the report identifies meaningful structural deletions
Bad case absent: substantive user decisions are not silently discarded and removed material is not rewritten as filler

evals.prompt: Process the two legacy comments in the attached outline. Produce the updated article source and feedback state.
evals.expected_output: The comparison comment is handled by planning; the prose comment is migrated verbatim into an open, anchored private Feedback thread for mf-write.
expectations: Good case: feedback is classified before action and the planning-owned request updates research or structure
Good case: the prose request becomes an unchecked FB-NNN thread with the original wording
Bad case absent: mf-plan does not rewrite the opening paragraph, resolve the writing thread, or silently delete either request
